---
title: "Apptainer"
subtitle: "Runs container images on HPC clusters as a normal user, without administrator rights (formerly Singularity)"
---

## Words

| Word | Meaning |
|------------|------------------------|
| `.sif` file | an Apptainer image: one read-only file you can copy, archive and run |
| definition file (`.def`) | a recipe that builds a `.sif`; ours starts from the project's Docker image |
| bind | a folder of the computer made visible inside the container; your home folder and the current folder are bound by default |

Apptainer runs on Linux only: on a Linux computer, in WSL2 on Windows, or on
{{< event cluster >}}, where it is often a module (`module load apptainer`).

## Build an image

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| From a Docker image on this computer | `apptainer build containers/ltee-project.sif docker-daemon://ltee-project:0.1.0` |
| From a registry, without Docker | `apptainer build containers/ltee-project.sif docker://ghcr.io/USER/ltee-project:0.1.0` |
| From the project's recipe | `apptainer build containers/ltee-project.sif containers/apptainer.def` |

See [lesson 08, section 7](../pages/08-containers.qmd#apptainer). The Docker
image comes from [section 5](../pages/08-containers.qmd#an-image-of-the-ltee-environment-from-pixi.lock),
and reaches the registry in [section 8](../pages/08-containers.qmd#archive-and-share-the-image).

## Run

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Run one command in it | `apptainer exec containers/ltee-project.sif samtools --version` |
| Run the image's start script, with arguments | `apptainer run containers/ltee-project.sif bash scripts/run_variant_calling.sh` |
| Run it as a cluster job (Slurm) | `srun -A PROJECT -t 00:30:00 apptainer run containers/ltee-project.sif ...` |

Apptainer runs as you and binds your home folder and the current folder by
itself, so it needs no `-v` (Docker does). `apptainer run` uses the image's
start script, which activates the environment; `apptainer exec` runs the
command directly.

## The recipe file

```{.default filename="containers/apptainer.def"}
Bootstrap: docker
From: ghcr.io/USER/ltee-project:0.1.0

%runscript
    exec /entrypoint.sh "$@"
```

## When it fails

| Problem | What to do |
|------------|------------------------|
| `apptainer: command not found` | use Linux, WSL2 or the cluster; there, try `module load apptainer` |
| `FATAL: ... user namespaces` | your system blocks unprivileged user namespaces: ask the administrator |
| The cluster has `singularity`, not `apptainer` | the same commands work with `singularity` in place of `apptainer` (SingularityCE is a separate fork by Sylabs) |

## Official cheat sheets and references

- Apptainer has no official cheat sheet. Its **Quick Start** is the closest: <https://apptainer.org/docs/user/latest/quick_start.html>
- Apptainer, *Command Line Interface* (every command): <https://apptainer.org/docs/user/latest/cli.html>
- Apptainer user guide: <https://apptainer.org/docs/user/latest/>
- To build the Docker image it starts from, see the [Docker](docker.qmd) cheat sheet.
